BSGS.scope: Source-generated independent BSGS entries; full cold/warm setup/online vectors remain in references.json. No timing claim.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Fresh A/A alias is unimplemented; deterministic original/incremental equality and independently checked known F11/F23 semantics qualify source only. This descriptive study makes no noise-floor/performance/null-inference claim; a fresh A/A release claim is withheld.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Host matched-M uniform and exact-mask orientation ensembles are descriptive conditional references, not exchangeable inferential null arms; no p-values. Their law/counts are frozen in extensions.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No extra fresh planted arm; known F11/F23 source controls checked before protocol, host BSGS verifies every actual target only after ACK. This does not qualify fresh detector sensitivity or a negative scientific verdict.

coverage.interpretation: Retained counts only; workload completeness is checked independently before labels, and partial rows are never padded.

manifest_completion.representation: published manifest.yaml is a yaml.safe_dump re-serialisation of the driver's values plus the added keys: comments and source formatting are not kept; the driver's exact bytes are in the execution receipt's manifest_completion.driver_manifest_text, hashed in driver_manifest_sha256

sources.run.inputs: frozen plan path and hash, frozen trial id, seed, parameters, curve_id
sources.run.result.executor_receipt: supervisor constant; the supervisor writes this file after completion
sources.run.timing: supervisor clock around the driver process
